question.en: Why did Patrick keep on asking the same question?
question.zh: 帕特里克为什么老是问同一个问题？

sentences.en: Why did Patrick keep on asking the same question?
sentences.zh: 帕特里克为什么老是问同一个问题？

sentences.en: The former Prime Minister, Mr. Wentworth Lane, was defeated in the recent elections.
sentences.zh: 前首相温特沃思·莱恩先生在最近的大选中被击败。

sentences.en: He is now retiring from political life and has gone abroad.
sentences.zh: 他现在正退出政界，已经出国了。

sentences.en: My friend, Patrick, has always been a fanatical opponent of Mr. Lane's Radical Progressive Party.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友帕特里克一直是莱恩先生激进进步党的狂热反对者。

chunks.x: of Mr. Lane 's Radical Progressive Party

sentences.en: After the elections, Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.
sentences.zh: 大选之后，帕特里克去了前首相的家。

chunks.x: to the former Prime Minister 's house

sentences.en: When he asked if Mr. Lane lived there, the policeman on duty told him that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.
sentences.zh: 当他问莱恩先生是否住在那里时，值班警察告诉他，这位前首相落选后已经出国了。

sentences.en: On the following day Patrick went to the house again.
sentences.zh: 第二天帕特里克又去了那所房子。

sentences.en: The same policeman was just walking slowly past the entrance, when Patrick asked the same question.
sentences.zh: 同一个警察正慢慢地从门口走过，帕特里克又问了同样的问题。

chunks.x: when Patrick asked the same question

sentences.en: Though a little suspicious this time the policeman gave him the same answer.
sentences.zh: 虽然这次警察有点怀疑，但还是给了他同样的回答。

chunks.x: the policeman gave him the same answer
Though a little suspicious this time the policeman gave him the same answer

sentences.en: Patrick went to the house once more and asked exactly the same question.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克又一次去了那所房子，问了完全相同的问题。

sentences.en: This time, the policeman lost his temper.
'I told you yesterday and the day before yesterday,' he shouted,
sentences.zh: “我昨天和前天都告诉过你了，”他喊道，

chunks.x: I told you yesterday and the day before yesterday

sentences.zh: “莱恩先生在大选中被击败了。

sentences.en: He has retired from political life and gone to live abroad!'
sentences.zh: 他已退出政界，到国外去住了！”

sentences.en: 'I know,' answered Patrick,' but I love to hear you say it!'
sentences.zh: “我知道，”帕特里克回答说，“可我就爱听你说这话！”
